# noozle_pulsar_outlet (Resource)

Manages a Noozle Pulsar outlet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "noozle_pulsar_outlet" "alerts" {
  name          = "Pulsar alerts"
  enabled       = true
  topic         = "persistent://public/default/noozle-alerts"
  url           = "pulsar://pulsar.example.com:6650"
  notify_policy = "FIRST_ONLY"

  transform {
    selected = "summarize"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `topic` (String) Pulsar topic.
- `url` (String) Pulsar broker URL.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `key` (String) Pulsar message key interpolation.
- `max_in_flight` (Number) Maximum number of in-flight Pulsar messages.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `oauth2` (Block, Optional) Optional inline OAuth2 feature for the Pulsar outlet. Conflicts with `token`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--oauth2))
- `ordering_key` (String) Pulsar ordering key interpolation.
- `tls` (Block, Optional) Optional inline TLS feature for the Pulsar outlet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tls))
- `token` (Block, Optional) Optional inline token feature for the Pulsar outlet. Conflicts with `oauth2`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--token))
- `transform` (Attributes) Optional outlet transform selection and observed runtime state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
